scoring_justification: Band gaps and gap types are read from the agent's CSV and compared to paper-reported PBE band gap values from Table S3 with a tolerance of 0.3 eV for the gap and exact string match for the gap type. This is a result-level comparison because raw Kohn-Sham eigenvalues are not required.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold PBE band gaps and gap types for three perovskite compounds
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table S3; (R)-MBAPbBr3: 2.60 eV indirect, (R)-MBAPbI3: 1.95 eV indirect, (R)-MBA2PbI4: 1.65 eV direct
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper supporting information Table S3 and confirmed with reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the paper's reported PBE band gaps; the tolerance of 0.3 eV accounts for computational spread while excluding random guesses.

outputs.description: PBE band gaps and gap type (direct/indirect) for (R)-MBAPbBr₃, (R)-MBAPbI₃, and (R)-MBA₂PbI₄.

steps.description: Check that reported band gaps (within 0.3 eV of paper values) and gap types are correct for all three compounds.
